identity.name: Linear
identity.tagline: The Issue Tracker Built for High-Performance Teams

voice.personality: Confident, highly refined, and focused on tangible velocity for modern teams.

painPoints: Wasting 15+ hours weekly maintaining manual setups
High friction when onboarding new team members
motivations: Enterprise peace of mind with continuous reliability

selectedConcept.hook: You didn't raise a Seed round to become a full-time Jira administrator.
selectedConcept.narrative: Starts with a exhausted engineering lead spending late Sunday evening fixing broken workflows and updating stale boards. Agitates the pain of spending 15+ hours weekly on configuration drift rather than shipping features. Introduces Linear's fluid Cycles and Roadmaps, demonstrating a 10x jump in issue triage velocity via keyboard shortcuts and automated workflows.
selectedConcept.visualMood: Dark obsidian studio lighting with high-contrast neon purple highlights and ultra-fast UI capture
selectedConcept.reasoning: Directly attacks the exact emotional drain tech founders and leads feel when managing legacy tools, anchoring Linear as the professional standard for fast-moving teams.

storyboard.pacingStrategy: Rapid visual hook (3s), fluid pain agitation (4s), high-speed proof (4s), authoritative closing (4s)

scenes.name: The Hook: The Jira Admin Trap
scenes.intent: Disrupt the scrolling feed with a relatable, high-stakes pain point for technical founders.
scenes.headlineCopy: You didn't raise a Seed round to become a full-time Jira administrator.
scenes.supportingCopy: The 15-Hour Engineering Tax is silently eating your runway.
scenes.visualDescription: A dark, cluttered interface overlay flickers with amber warning indicators. High-contrast typography cuts through dark grid lines as ambient red light pulses subtly in the background.
scenes.pacingNotes: Stagger kinetic text entrance by 4 frames per line for maximum punch.

elementIntents.description: Kinetic bold typography snapping into position
Warning indicator flickering with '15 HRS/WK WASTED'

scenes.name: Agitation: The Configuration Drift
scenes.intent: Quantify lost velocity and emphasize the frustration of administrative overhead.
scenes.headlineCopy: 15+ hours weekly spent fighting configuration drift.
scenes.supportingCopy: Stale boards. Broken workflows. Late Sunday ticket updates.
scenes.visualDescription: An abstract, decaying stack of complex project management tickets fragments into visual clutter. A timer rapidly ramps up from 0 to 15 hours in muted crimson before dissolving.
scenes.pacingNotes: Fast cuts on visual fragmentation synced to a rhythmic low-frequency audio ticking beat.

elementIntents.description: Authoritative sans-serif copy detailing hours lost
Shattering UI cards representing legacy project management tools

scenes.name: Solution & Proof: 10x Triage Velocity
scenes.intent: Demonstrate Linear's speed, keyboard-first navigation, and fluid workflow automation.
scenes.supportingCopy: Fluid Cycles & Roadmaps powered by keyboard-first precision.
scenes.visualDescription: A dramatic reveal of Linear's sleek dark UI with signature #5E6AD2 indigo ambient illumination. Keyboard shortcut overlays (CMD+K) trigger instant issue sorting and automatic cycle assignment at 60fps.
scenes.pacingNotes: Ultra-fluid spring animations with crisp 120fps-style movement for UI elements.

elementIntents.description: Massive glowing '10x' metric overlay in Linear brand purple (#5E6AD2)
Ultra-fast screencast of Linear Cycles and shortcut commands

scenes.name: Call To Action: Reclaim Your Runway
scenes.intent: Drive immediate migration to Linear for high-performance engineering teams.
scenes.headlineCopy: Stop paying the engineering tax. Built for speed.
scenes.visualDescription: Clean, minimal lockup featuring the Linear logo emitting a soft #5E6AD2 backlight. A crisp 'Start Free Trial' button renders with a modern glow border.
scenes.pacingNotes: Hold steady on lockup for the final 2 seconds to maximize brand recall.

elementIntents.description: Bold closing statement commanding immediate action
Linear wordmark and brand mark with #5E6AD2 ambient glow
High-contrast CTA button ready for conversion
